verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI privacy docs say its AI features are opt-in and "do not store or train on your data." Organizations can also request a complete block of AI features through support. Together these amount to a vendor-set no-retention posture for AI processing, not user-controlled retention or deletion. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods, self-serve data deletion or export controls, documentation of retention for non-AI platform data, and independent corroboration.
